Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — attached are Marketly's annotated redlines to the Reseller Addendum (MSA + Order Form references). The key items we've flagged:

- Fee routing: we prefer net-of-marketplace-fee gross-to-seller routing (see §4).
- Indemnity allocation: we asked for a carveout for brokered-fraud claims tied to Marketplace processing nodes.
- Audit scope: limited to invoice level and not full product telemetry.

We also added a short reconciliation timeline and a request for a separate addendum page for marketplace refunds. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept the proposed net-vs-gross language or if you prefer a revenue-share structure.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum (redlines attached)

Thanks — quick summary below that we can send to Marketly as attorney comments.

1) Fee routing (§4): Redwood cannot accept a blanket "net-of-marketplace-fee" routing without contractually binding the marketplace operator to indemnify Redwood for payment disputes, refunds, and chargebacks. Proposed language: allow net routing only where an approved marketplace operator signs the Marketplace Processing Rider (MPR) which includes: liability cap for disputed transactions, obligations to maintain transaction logs for 18 months, and a requirement to support forensic reconciliation on request.

2) Indemnity allocation: We will not accept language that shifts third-party fraud exposure to Redwood. Counter-proposal: allocate indemnity to the party that controls the payment flow and retains settlement receipts. If Marketly is the channel partner, they must retain primary indemnity for broker-mediated claims.

3) Audit scope: Limit to invoicing records and payment reconciliation artifacts (invoices, settlement reports, refund memos). No live telemetry or backend access. Period: prior 24 months, subject to 14 days' notice and in a secured read-only manner.

4) Implementation/ops ask (Ben): if we accept MPR model, provide a short runbook we require from the marketplace operator (log schema, S3 export cadence, reconciliation API).

Attachments: internal_redline_outline.txt (summary)

If you want, I can transform these bullets into track-changes to send back. Otherwise, we can schedule the call with Marketly legal on Fri 12:00 PT — I think it will be necessary to get them on the MPR concept.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
